subject.title: fix(feishu): disable ambient proxy inheritance for WebSocket by default

question: Should Feishu WebSocket egress change from ambient-proxy-by-default to direct-by-default with `OPENCLAW_FEISHU_WS_USE_PROXY=1` opt-in, or should proxy inheritance remain the upgrade default?
rationale: The patch fixes a real direct-connect failure mode but also changes compatibility and an egress-control security boundary for existing proxy-dependent deployments.

options.title: Finish Direct Default
options.body: Require docs, real transport proof, env cleanup, and conflict resolution before accepting direct-by-default WebSocket egress.

options.title: Preserve Proxy Default
options.body: Keep ambient proxy inheritance as the upgrade default and ask for a separate explicit Feishu direct/bypass mode.

options.title: Pause For Broader Policy
options.body: Hold this PR until the broader Feishu HTTP and mixed-proxy policy work is decided.

recommendation.title: Finish Direct Default
recommendation.body: Require docs, real transport proof, env cleanup, and conflict resolution before accepting direct-by-default WebSocket egress.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author explicitly requested this decision from this handle, and history ties this handle to the shared proxy helper used by the affected path.
